item.title: Balanced Sampling of a Tagged Training Pool: Formulation and Solvers
item.description: Resampling a tagged training pool to scenario targets: collapsing frames into tag-combination patterns, a convex quadratic programme over pattern weights, and a comparison of FISTA with a dual semismooth Newton solver on a real pool.
